create_mask_collator: create a MaskCollator with mask config list, crop size, num frames, patch size, and tubelet size
call_mask_collator: call the MaskCollator on a batch to get collated batch, encoder masks, and predictor masks
step_mask_collator: step the MaskCollator to increment iteration counters across all mask generators
create_mask_generator: create a _MaskGenerator with crop size, num frames, spatial and temporal patch sizes, and masking ratio
call_mask_generator: call the _MaskGenerator with a batch size to generate encoder and predictor mask tensors
